# Ohio Valley Land Partners
> A direct regional land buyer serving the Ohio Valley.
> Ohio Valley Land Partners studies each property, reviews direct acquisition inquiries as a prospective principal buyer, and explains the process clearly.
> Requesting a review creates no obligation to sell, and not every property receives a proposal.

## Core Pages
- /: Homepage — services overview, counties served, process summary
- /about: Company background, principal introduction, and 5% community-reinvestment commitment
- /contact: Submit a property for internal acquisition review
- /land: Direct property-review and seller-process page
- /community: Community commitment — 5% of company profits committed to local reinvestment as the business grows
- /land-scouts: Introductions and local partnerships; no compensation is promised

## Service Area
Ohio counties: Belmont, Jefferson, Columbiana, Harrison, Carroll
West Virginia counties: Ohio County, Marshall, Brooke
Current acquisition focus also includes Franklin County, Ohio and portions of Geauga County, Ohio. Focus varies by county and campaign.

## Key Facts
- Principal buyer — not a licensed real estate broker
- Property-specific purchase proposals may be presented after review; no purchase, price, or timing is guaranteed
- Closing terms and timing depend on the written agreement, title review, and property-specific conditions
- Considers a range of parcel conditions while directing legal, tax, title, and valuation questions to licensed professionals
- OVLP has committed 5% of company profits to local community reinvestment as the business grows
- Headquarters: 2025 Riverside Drive STE 35682, Columbus, OH 43221
- Phone: (614) 653-7430
- Email: info@ohiovalleylandpartners.com
- Principal-led regional buyer with direct property review and owner communication
